chunks: Then circumambulate the House in seven circuits, and kiss the Stone in every circuit, and keep your steps close together. When you reach the door of the House, say: “Your beggar, Your needy one, is at Your door, so bestow charity upon him with Paradise. O Allah, the House is Your House, the sanctuary is Your sanctuary, the servant is Your servant, and this is the station of one seeking refuge, seeking protection through You from the Fire. So free me, my parents, my family, my children, and my believing brothers from the Fire, O Munificent, O Generous.”

When you reach the point opposite the water spout, say: “O Allah, free my neck from the Fire, expand for me from lawful provision, and avert from me the evil of the sinful among the Arabs and the non-Arabs, and the evil of the sinful among the jinn and humankind.” And say while you pass: “O Allah, indeed I am poor before You, and indeed I am fearful of You and seeking refuge, so do not change my name, and do not alter my body.”

key_terms.الرِّزْقِ الْحَلَالِ: lawful sustenance and provision granted by Allah
key_terms.الطَّوَافُ: the ritual circumambulation of the Ka'bah during hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: the Sacred House, meaning the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْحَجَرَ: the Black Stone touched or kissed during tawaf
key_terms.الْحَرَمُ: the sacred sanctuary surrounding the Ka'bah
key_terms.الْمِيزَابِ: the water spout of the Ka'bah, a known point during tawaf

ai.seo_question: What supplications are recited during tawaf in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage gives devotional instructions for tawaf, combining ritual movement around the Ka'bah with specific supplications at designated points. It emphasizes humility before Allah, seeking lawful provision, protection from evil, and deliverance from the Fire for oneself and one's believing family and brethren.
